description:
Director of Finance

**Commercial Strategy | Profitable Growth | Finance Transformation**

The Opportunity

**Help shape the business. Influence strategy. Build a stronger financial foundation for growth.**

We are seeking a commercially minded, hands-on Director of Finance to play an influential role in the continued growth and evolution of a growing, entrepreneurial business.

This is an opportunity for a finance leader who enjoys being close to the business, working directly with executive leadership, and having a tangible impact on financial and commercial decisions. Unlike highly structured corporate finance environments, this role offers broad visibility, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence multiple areas of the organization.

Working closely with executive leadership, Sales, and Product Development, you will help drive profitable growth by evaluating customer economics, pricing strategies, product profitability, trade spend, and margin performance.

You will bring the ability to look beyond the numbers, challenge conventional thinking, and translate financial insights into practical business strategies. Equally important, you will help elevate the finance function by strengthening processes, building analytical capabilities, and developing a team that serves as a true business partner to the organization.

For someone who thrives in a growing company where initiative, flexibility, and the ability to make things happen matter, this is an opportunity to have a meaningful seat at the table and leave a lasting impact.

What You'll Lead

**Commercial Strategy & Profitability**

* Partner directly with executive leadership and Sales to evaluate pricing, customer profitability, promotional strategies, and margin opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability while supporting sustainable revenue growth.
* Translate financial analysis into actionable commercial recommendations.

**Trade Spend & Retail Economics**

* Improve visibility and accountability around trade spend, retailer deductions, dilution, chargebacks, and gross-to-net revenue.
* Identify root causes of margin erosion and develop strategies to improve commercial returns.
* Partner with Sales to better understand customer economics and optimize financial performance.

**Product & Customer Performance**

* Work cross-functionally with Sales and Product Development to evaluate product economics, new product investments, customer opportunities, and growth initiatives.
* Provide financial insight to support business decisions and resource allocation.

**Financial Strategy & Performance**

* Own budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and performance analysis.
* Provide leadership with meaningful financial insights and recommendations.
* Develop reporting and analytical tools that improve visibility into business performance.

**Finance Transformation & Operational Improvement**

* Strengthen and modernize financial processes, reporting, analytics, and internal controls.
* Bring structure, discipline, and scalability to the finance function without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and decision-making.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a capable finance team.
* Foster a culture of accountability, analytical thinking, and cross-functional partnership.
* Build a finance organization that is proactive, solutions-oriented, and closely connected to the business.

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally within a small to mid-sized, growing organization.
* Experience in CPG, consumer products, manufacturing, or businesses serving large retail or big-box customers.
* A background that combines financial planning and analysis, commercial finance, and operational business partnership.
* Strong understanding of trade spend, retailer deductions, dilution, chargebacks, promotional investments, and gross-to-net revenue.
* Demonstrated success improving profitability, strengthening margins, and influencing commercial decisions.
* Experience working directly with executive leadership, business owners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* The ability to operate both strategically and tactically, balancing big-picture thinking with hands-on execution.
* Experience building, improving, or transforming finance processes and capabilities in a growing business.
* A practical, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to navigate an environment where not everything is already built or fully established.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You are likely someone who has grown alongside a business, taken on increasing responsibility, and enjoys having a broader impact than a traditional finance role might offer.

You are comfortable rolling up your sleeves, digging into the details, and stepping back to influence the bigger picture. You don't need a large corporate infrastructure or layers of support to get things done. Instead, you enjoy identifying what needs to improve, taking ownership, and building solutions.

You understand that finance is not simply about reporting what happened. It's about helping the business determine what should happen next.

You enjoy partnering with Sales, Product Development, and executive leadership, challenging assumptions, and bringing financial discipline to commercial decisions.

Most importantly, you're motivated by the opportunity to help build something—to strengthen a growing organization, develop a finance team, and directly influence the company's future.

**If you're a finance leader looking for greater ownership, broader business exposure, and the opportunity to make a visible impact within a growing organization, this could be an exciting next step.**

title: HR & Recruiting Lead
description:
**HR & Recruiting Lead**
========================

**About Shade**
---------------

Shade is scaling and fast. In a year and half, we've built out the combined tech of FrameIO (acq by Adobe for $1.275B) and LucidLink ($40M ARR) while combining it with proprietary AI search/labeling. We handle thousands of hours of video and tens of millions of requests every day, and we're a critical piece of infrastructure for post-production houses, creative agencies, sports teams, and internal media teams at large companies. Customers include The New York Times, HelloFresh, Ripple, Fidelity, and Columbia University. We're growing 150% QoQ, 120% NRR.

Backed by Khosla, General Catalyst, Contrary, Signalfire and Bling.

**About the Role**
------------------

Recruiting comes first. You'll own every search end to end, from sourcing to close, across GTM, technical, and operations roles, with five open today. You'll also support HR operations with our bizops team, including onboarding, benefits, leave, and compliance.

You'll work cross-functionally with hiring managers across the company and with our ops team.

**What You'll Own & Achieve**
-----------------------------

* Own full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, interview loops, references, and closing, with several searches running in parallel
* Own the hiring plan and the funnel metrics behind it: time-to-fill, stage pass-through, offer-accept rate, and source effectiveness
* Manage our recruiting agencies, decide when a search justifies a placement fee, and bring the rest in-house
* Build the hiring infrastructure we don't have yet: scorecards, structured interview loops, a consistent offer process, and an employer brand
* Run onboarding so new hires are productive in their first weeks, and support HR operations with our bizops team: Rippling, benefits and open enrollment, leave, compliance, and policies
* Stand up performance review and feedback cycles, and keep leveling, compensation bands, and offer decisions consistent as headcount grows

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4+ years across recruiting and people operations, including time as a first or early People hire at a VC-backed startup
* Experience personally sourcing and closing candidates for both sales and technical roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, Ashby, and/or Juicebox
* Experience running onboarding, benefits, policies, and HRIS without a larger team
* A habit of tracking search performance, including time-to-fill, candidate drop-off, and offer acceptance
* Discretion with sensitive information
* High ownership: you spot problems early and see changes through, on your own or with cross-functional partners
* Comfortable building without a finished playbook

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Rippling administration experience
* GTM hiring at a B2B SaaS company
* Experience planning team offsites and company events

**How We Work**
---------------

Our team is flexible, moves quickly, and is always interested in new technologies and ideas to accelerate development and improve our processes. We value people who take ownership, communicate proactively, and bring fresh ideas to the table. You won't be handed a fully built playbook — you'll help write it.

**Perks!**
----------

You are more than "shareholder value." We build our team around personal investment and ambition, so we offer benefits like:

* Office snacks, free lunch, comp-ed dinners
* Full health insurance (w. dental & vision), 401k with % match
* Unlimited PTO
* Lifetime gym membership
* Commuter cards for subway/bus —> we work in-person
* ^^ You'll want to work in-person! We are fun! Our office is cool!

And, of course, these are in addition to salary and equity. At Shade, you are the "shareholder."

**Compensation**
----------------

$140k-$170k plus equity.

99% of care happens when someone steps outside the four walls of a doctor's office. Hera is creating a new profession in healthcare to fill that gap: the Hero, a dedicated senior care expert for your family. Our Heroes educate, coordinate, and advocate for the most vulnerable population in the healthcare system. We’re covered by insurance, so we can serve every family in America.
  
  
**Building the most trusted interface of healthcare**
We are in the business of trust.
  
  
We're designing for the most emotionally charged moments of our customers' lives; the bar isn't just delight, it's trust. Hera's brand promise is simple: care worthy of our parents. This promise is our moat.
  
  
It's what physicians refer to, families buy, what Heroes deliver, and what the product must unlock and enforce at every touchpoint.
  
  
**Our product challenge**
The bottleneck isn't demand, it's supply. There aren't enough experts to serve every family who needs us. To scale to all of America, we have to unbundle expertise from the human so that anyone who can foster human connection can become a Hero.
  
  
The problem is that this expertise is tribal knowledge. One social worker knows how to expedite Medicaid in New York, another knows which home-visiting PT families actually love. It's trapped in people's heads.
  
  
To solve this, our platform captures every interaction and turns it into compounding intelligence that makes every user smarter. Think Waymo: expert humans do the driving today, and every mile they log trains the system so that tomorrow, anyone — even with zero healthcare background — can perform like a 20-year veteran. The hard part is building a system that knows what to trust, what's gone stale, what's local versus universal, and how to surface the right insight at the right moment. The customer feedback is the most positive our team has seen in our careers. Along the way, we threw an art show for an 88 year old artist that went viral and a talent show where every act is over 65.
  
  
You’ll build Hera alongside co-founders Jenny, Myles & Connie and a team from Palantir and Headway. We are in person in NYC. Read our story and watch our launch video here.
  
  
**Join us to build our Strategic Finance function**
At most companies, finance is a reporting function: close the books, build the budget, explain the variance. This role is different; it is not an FP&A role. At Hera, you're in the room for every big investment we make, and you own the math behind it. You’ll bring the analytical rigor of a seasoned financier and the ethos of a strong operator: surgical execution, relentless truth seeking and an obsession with greatness. You'll work through hard tradeoffs in the business and then go make it happen.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
  
  
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
  
  
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Square’s Strategic Finance team partners with our go-to-market leaders to make sure our biggest commercial decisions drive both growth and profitability. * Advanced financial modeling skills, including building P&L and unit economics models from scratch
* Sound commercial judgment when weighing growth, margin, and risk in a deal
* Experience building trusted relationships with senior leaders and presenting analysis and recommendations that shape their decisions
* A track record of owning projects end to end, from framing the question to implementing the decision
* A habit of building repeatable systems rather than one-off answers, and comfort using AI tools to scale your work

They must be proficient in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. Interest in the challenges facing global business, particularly technology, is a plus, as is an understanding of how to create compelling presentations and infographics.

This is an entry level role that provides good development opportunities, particularly as the fast-growing Thought Leadership team expands its capabilities. Successful candidates can expect to get client-facing experience at an early stage and progress to managing a portfolio of Thought Leadership projects across varied topic areas, as well as developing their own areas of expertise. The role requires working closely with clients and colleagues around the world, often working on projects with colleagues in our UK offices and elsewhere.

**This is not an economist or data analytics position. The Research Associate position on the Thought Leadership team is a business research, writing, and analysis role.**

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

*Research and analysis*

* Assist project managers in conducting the necessary industry and company research to ensure the accuracy, currency, and comprehensiveness of the information in our published reports
* Help to draft surveys related to research projects
* Review and quality-assure primary research data (e.g., survey responses)
* Contribute to survey analysis to develop data insights
* Work with survey team throughout research projects, from specifying requirements through to data delivery
* Manage survey fieldwork, including regular progress updates and receipt of interim and final deliverables
* Work with other team members to specify project data presentation and analysis requirements
* Assist in building charts, graphs, dashboards, and data visualizations
* Assist editors in checking quotes, facts, and data in reports
* Respond to client data queries, carrying out investigations as required

*Administration*

* Manage project documentation, including proposals, contracts, data files, and client deliverables
* Help coordinate Thought Leadership projects with external contributors (e.g., expert interviews)
* Put relevant thought leadership materials on our corporate website
Work with other team members to ensure proper project time recording and accurate financial records  

**Performance Measures**  
The metrics against which the research associate’s performance will be assessed include:

* Quality of analysis, presentation, and other deliverables
* Completion of assignments on time and to the appropriate level of quality
* Accuracy and reliability of documentation and record keeping
* Feedback from Thought Leadership team and clients

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

*Education and training*

* Bachelor's degree
* Awareness and interest in business, economic, and social trends
* Highly numerate, with some research and data analysis experience an advantage

*Skills*

* Ability to manipulate and analyze data in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Writing ability, presenting a convincing argument based on evidence
* Copyediting and proofreading skills
* Strong organizational and administrative skills, with experience of supplier and project administration an advantage

*Personal attributes*

* Detail-oriented and conscientious
* Self-starter, with can-do attitude
* Ability to hit deadlines and finish assignments quickly
* Flexible, able to react quickly to changing requirements
* Able to take direction
* Ability to thrive in a hybrid working environment (at least 2 days in the office per week)

We employ more than 400 professional economists, industry experts and business editors—one of the largest teams of macroeconomists and thought leadership specialists. title: Manager of IT
description:
### **Who We Are**

Nightingale Veterinary Partners is a fast-growing family of veterinary practices, headquartered in New York City. The organization includes veterinary practices in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Philadelphia, Massachusetts and Florida.

We are building a company focused on clinical excellence, sustainable growth, and long-term value creation. As we grow, we are seeking a hands-on technology professional who wants to help build reliable IT operations and support the teams caring for our patients.

  

### **About the Role**

Nightingale Veterinary Partners is seeking a hands-on Manager of IT to manage daily IT operations across our home office and veterinary practices. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), you will take responsibility for support delivery, infrastructure maintenance, vendor coordination, and technology projects.

This role combines technical work with day-to-day operational leadership. You will troubleshoot issues, configure equipment, and visit practices while coordinating support priorities, guiding IT colleagues, and improving how we work. You will partner with the CTO to put technology and security priorities into practice and keep projects moving.

You should enjoy solving technical problems, follow through on commitments, and communicate clearly with practice teams. You will move between onsite troubleshooting and planning technology for new locations.

This is a hands-on, in-office role based in New York City with regular travel to local Nightingale veterinary practices.

  

### **What You Would Do**

* Manage daily IT support across practice locations and the home office, prioritizing requests and outages based on their impact on operations and patient care.

* Provide hands-on troubleshooting and serve as an escalation point for hardware, software, networking, and connectivity issues.

* Coordinate day-to-day work across IT colleagues and external support partners, track issues through resolution, and mentor junior team members.

* Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and related systems, including user access, device management, and employee onboarding and offboarding.

* Administer Google Business ecosystem, including gmail and Google business tools

* Configure and maintain network infrastructure, including LAN/WAN connectivity, VLANs, wireless networks, firewalls, and VPNs.

* Implement and maintain security controls with the CTO and security partners, including MFA, SSO, endpoint protection, backups, recovery procedures, and remediation of identified vulnerabilities.

* Coordinate technology setup for new practices, including equipment procurement, installation, testing, onsite launch support, and handoff to ongoing support resources.

* Manage day-to-day vendor and managed-service relationships, tracking service quality, project timelines, and spending against approved budgets.

* Establish and maintain support procedures, technical documentation, and deployment standards so each location receives consistent service.

* Keep the CTO informed of recurring issues, security concerns, and project progress; recommend practical improvements to reliability and the user experience.

  

### **What We Require**

* 5+ years of progressive IT experience spanning infrastructure, systems administration, and end-user support.

* Experience coordinating IT support, leading technical projects, or guiding junior colleagues, with accountability for follow-through and results.

* Experience supporting IT operations across multiple physical locations.

* Strong hands-on skills with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, user administration, and access management.

* Strong networking fundamentals and experience configuring and troubleshooting VLANs, wireless networks, firewalls, and VPNs.

* Practical knowledge of cybersecurity controls, endpoint protection, and backup and recovery processes.

* Experience working with technology vendors or managed-service providers and holding them accountable for delivery.

* Ability to troubleshoot independently, manage competing priorities, and explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical colleagues.

* Comfort working onsite, traveling to practices, and adapting to changing needs in a growing organization.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience supervising IT staff. Formal management experience is preferred, not required.

* Experience in veterinary medicine, healthcare services, dental, or physician practice management.

* Experience with Cisco Meraki, SonicWall, Ubiquiti, or comparable networking and firewall platforms.

* Familiarity with ezyVet or other practice-management systems.

* Experience supporting PCI-DSS compliance or cyber-insurance requirements.

* Relevant Microsoft, Cisco, CompTIA Network+, Security+, or equivalent certifications.

* A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

### **Travel**

Regular local travel is required, particularly throughout New York City, New Jersey, Connecticut, and the surrounding region. New-practice launches outside the immediate area may occasionally require several consecutive days or up to a week onsite.

Once a practice is operational, ongoing local support will generally transition to appropriate local resources. You should be comfortable with both regular site visits and occasional extended travel for launches.

  

### **What We Offer**

* Annual base salary of $100k-$120k. Compensation will depend on the candidate's skills, experience, and competencies.

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

* Generous PTO

* 401(k) with a company match

* Paid parental leave

* Wellness support/EAP

* MetLife voluntary benefits

* Employee pet discounts

* Flexible spending account

* Discounted pet insurance through MetLife

The Manager of Finance Operations will be responsible for leading a subset of the Accounts Payable function for all of our US brands (HelloFresh, EveryPlate, Green Chef, Factor and GDL). This position will be responsible for managing people based in NYC, CO and/or offshore in the Philippines.

The Finance Operations organization provides the backbone operational processes for the US business by paying HelloFresh's suppliers on time and supporting the Accounting & Finance teams in reporting financial results.

Our team is focused on building a better experience for our business partners, streamlining processes and increasing controllership. This position requires the candidate to diagnose current processes and metrics, identify opportunities, work with business partners to identify and implement improvements and validate the improvement effort.

You will be responsible for identifying the opportunities across the procure to pay processes, prioritizing the improvement opportunities and partnering with business and technology leadership to successfully execute improvements. This role requires the ability to demonstrate ownership, interpret data, and effectively influence to drive meaningful results translating to tangible productivity and efficiency gains across multiple departments. To succeed, you must have the ability to engage deeply with diverse business partners, earn trust using facts and data, and have a demonstrated ability to advise and influence the decisions of senior business leaders through effective verbal and written communication. * Managing the team in the day to day operations of timely payment of invoices as well as supporting their career development

* Solve critical vendor, process and system escalations effectively to ensure root cause analysis and effective problem resolution
* Identify and quantify financial and operational risks and opportunities
* Support both internal and external audit and ensuring compliance and audit-readiness of all AP processes
* Assisting in the month end close process

* 7+ years of finance experience and experience in a high volume AP &/or AR environment
* BA/BS degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting or other related fields
* Ability to work across global time zones and occasional travel may be required
* Able to work comfortably under pressure and work towards tight deadlines.
* A strong sense of ownership and attention to detail.
* Drive to continuously improve and build processes.
* Ability to manage a high-volume workload efficiently and effectively
* Willingness to partner with and support other functions
* Experience in leading a diverse team both onshore and offshore

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in e-commerce especially with supply-chain
* Track record of providing advice to senior leaders and driving results
* Experience working with vendors as either a buyer or financial analyst/manager
* Experience in Accounts Payable (procure to pay), Accounts Receivable (order to cash), and/or Customer Service environment
* Excellent financial modeling and data analytics skills, including Excel, Tableau, Access, SQL, ETL, and other analysis tools
* Experience with AP functionality of ERP systems; Oracle Cloud Fusion knowledge is a plus

***You'll get…***

* Competitive salary and 401(k) with company match (vesting immediately upon participation)
* Generous PTO policy and 4 weeks of parental leave
* $0 monthly premium and flexible health plans starting on day one
* 85% discount on your HelloFresh subscription and other product offerings
* A collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

title: Strategic Account Director - Issuer Partnerships
description:

As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

**Overall Purpose**

The Strategic Account Director is responsible for Paze’s most strategic issuer partnerships including EWS’s owner banks. This role drives partner strategy and manages senior relationships to ensure Paze’s growth via direct and indirect investment in our product and strategy. The Strategic Account Director will play a critical role in the success of Paze, maintaining and launching new strategic issuer partnerships, iterating on go-to-market approach, and helping to build out the strategic accounts team. The primary objective of the role is to drive Paze’s transaction growth by ensuring our top issuing partners deliver best-in-class deployments of Paze.

* Develops trusted, influential relationships with key decision makers at our largest, most strategic issuer partners. This includes Paze advisory committee members and leaders in product/digital, marketing, risk, technology, or other functions critical to Paze’s success.
* Primary owner of assigned strategic issuer partners. Requires foremost expertise of partner organizational structure/decision making, company performance, strategic initiatives, product/services, state of EWS-wide relationship, as well as a consistent pulse on the state of Paze performance (e.g., KPIs, user experience), active opportunities and challenges/threats.
* Launches and develops select new strategic issuer partnerships.
* Ensures the retention, growth and customer satisfaction of key issuer partners.
* Develops overall strategic plan (annual, quarterly, and monthly priorities) in close coordination with Paze cross-functional teams and senior leadership. Aligns and gains commitment from strategic partners on overall plan, holding partners and internal stakeholders accountable for execution and results.

* Evaluates program trends and provides analysis and recommendations to management.
* Plays a key role in defining product market fit for Paze products, driving influence across Paze as the voice of the issuer and market.
* Monitors competitor activity at issuers and implements strategies to drive Paze prioritization over competing investments.
* Supports the company’s commitment to risk management and protect the integrity and confidentiality of systems and data.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education and experience typically obtained through completion of a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, or related field.
* Typically, a minimum of 15 years in partner-management roles, such business development, relationship management, and/or consulting and 8+ years of experience working on financial services products, including payments.
* Experience managing complex strategic partners with a myriad of decision makers.
* Proven ability to develop and foster impactful relationships with senior leadership. Outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong internal and external relationships.
* Track record of driving change and accomplishing strategic objectives within partner organizations.
* Consultative, conceptual, and strategic selling skills. Strong influencing skills, able to sell concepts internally and drive streamlined decision making across partners.
 [...] **Preferred qualifications**
* Experience working at a card issuing bank, payment network, or an established payments fintech as an issuing bank partner.
* Deep payments expertise, namely in digital wallets, tokenization, and eCommerce and NFC payments.
* Product development experience and passion for great consumer financial products.
* MBA.
**Physical Requirements**
Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers and travel.
Employee must be able to perform essential functions and physical requirements of position with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Early Careers Launch - Investment Banking Trainee**
-----------------------------------------------------

Are you ready to elevate your career in the investment banking sector? Do you possess the skills to contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment? This is your chance to create a significant impact at Aon Reinsurance!

This is role out of our New York City Office.

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**
----------------------------------------------

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**
-------------------------------

Join a team of professionals at Aon dedicated to providing corporate finance and investment banking advisory services to Aon’s (re)insurance clients. This client-facing position includes modeling financial and valuation impacts of strategic choices clients evaluate. These include buyside and sellside M&A, restructuring, raising capital, structuring reinsurance programs, applying captives and alternative risk management strategies, and entering or exiting business lines or geographies.

You will collaborate within a group setting on a variety of tasks, including:

  

* Financial Modeling – building three statement financial models and projections, discounted cash flow models and M&A combination analyses.
* Financial Analysis – reviewing both public and confidential information about companies, their peers, and information about precedent transactions to identify trends relevant to our clients and their goals.
* Valuation Analyses – conducting comparable company, comparable transaction, regression, and discounted cash flow analyses.
* Presentation Development – assisting in crafting investment banking marketing materials, presentations for senior management, and board-level client presentations summarizing findings and recommendations.
* Synthesizing information and making recommendations involves combining data from clients and colleagues to inform financial projections. It also includes proactively identifying alternative ideas and solutions to meet client goals.
* Industry Research – tracking (re)insurance industry trends and translating that information into insights that aid client recommendations.
* Maintaining and Establishing Client Relationships – developing relationships within the Aon organization and growing existing client relationships.

**How this opportunity is different**
-------------------------------------

The Corporate Finance team is an integral part of the broader U.S. Aon Capital Advisory group, a firm-wide collaboration that combines expertise across Aon’s fields, including Corporate Finance, Analytics, Reinsurance Solutions, and Investment Banking practices.

The group’s goal is to bring to bear our collective experience to provide tailored, objective, and comprehensive advice on the capital supporting clients’ business. They also focus on how this capital can be optimized. The group is led by a senior Aon executive with oversight from the Chief Strategy Officer and Global Head of Analytics for Aon Reinsurance Solutions.

on real-world, economically valuable, complex accounting tasks. They've been a great collaborator in helping us shape what the future of agents looks like." — Prashant Mital, Applied AI Lead, OpenAI*
Why finance matters here
  
  
Most finance roles inherit a business model. This one helps build one.
  
  
Our agents do work that accounting firms have always staffed with people. That makes the questions finance owns at Basis the questions that decide whether the company works: how you price hours of autonomous work, what margins look like when compute is a real cost of revenue, how far ahead of demand you build capacity, and where the next dollar of a fundraise should go. There is no playbook for this yet. You’ll help write it.

* Take analysis to action. Evaluating a pricing change or a new investment is half the job. The other half is getting the right people aligned and making sure the decision actually gets implemented. You follow the number until something changes because of it.

**Position Summary**

The Trade Documentary Examiner is responsible for the detailed review, examination, and processing of import, export, and standby letter of credit presentations. This position ensures that all documents comply with the terms and conditions of the applicable letter of credit, international trade finance standards, regulatory requirements, and the Bank's internal policies and procedures.

The successful candidate will possess substantial hands-on experience in documentary examination, a strong understanding of international trade finance practices, and the ability to identify discrepancies, assess transaction risk, and communicate effectively with clients, financial institutions, and internal stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Documentary Examination and Trade Finance Operations**

* Examine import and export documents presented under commercial and standby letters of credit to determine compliance with the credit's terms and conditions.
* Apply the Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP 600), International Standard Banking Practice (ISBP), and other applicable international trade finance rules when reviewing documentary presentations.
* Review commercial invoices, bills of lading, airway bills, packing lists, certificates of origin, insurance documents, inspection certificates, and other trade-related documentation.
* Identify, analyze, and document discrepancies, including inconsistencies in document descriptions, dates, amounts, shipment details, signatures, and other requirements stipulated in the letter of credit.
* Determine whether presentations are compliant, require further review, or should be refused based on applicable rules and Bank procedures.
* Process payments for compliant presentations and coordinate the resolution of outstanding issues before payment or settlement.

* Review transaction instructions, verify applicable deadlines, and monitor presentation, acceptance, maturity, and payment dates.
* Obtain required internal approvals, customer authorizations, waivers, and payment instructions before proceeding with transactions.
* Prepare accurate and timely discrepancy notices, document refusal notices, payment confirmations, and other transaction-related correspondence.
* Coordinate with issuing banks, advising banks, confirming banks, beneficiaries, applicants, and other counterparties to resolve documentary issues and facilitate transaction processing.

### **Compliance and Risk Management**

* Conduct or coordinate sanctions screening and applicable compliance checks in accordance with Bank policies, regulatory requirements, and established escalation procedures.
* Identify potential sanctions, financial crime, fraud, or other compliance concerns and promptly escalate exceptions to the appropriate internal departments.
* Follow applicable requirements relating to anti-money laundering (AML), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) compliance, and Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions, as relevant to assigned transactions and internal procedures.
* Ensure documentary examination and payment decisions are supported by appropriate documentation, approvals, and transaction records.
* Maintain awareness of changes to international trade finance rules, banking regulations, and internal operating procedures that may affect documentary examination.
* Protect confidential customer and transaction information and adhere to the Bank's operational risk and information security standards.

### **Recordkeeping and Operational Controls**

* Maintain complete, accurate, and organized records of documentary presentations, examination findings, approvals, discrepancies, payments, acceptances, and related correspondence.

description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

**Position Description**

PIMCO is seeking an experienced commercial real estate financing professional to join its Private Strategies Portfolio Management team in New York.

The individual will be responsible for sourcing, structuring, negotiating and managing financing solutions across PIMCO's commercial real estate investment strategies, with a particular focus on obtaining leverage against commercial real estate debt and equity portfolios and investment vehicles.

The role will work closely with portfolio managers across PIMCO's private strategies and serve as a key interface with banks and other financing counterparties. The individual will evaluate financing alternatives, negotiate financing terms and documentation, execute new facilities, and actively manage existing financing arrangements.

The role would also involve the opportunity to deploy capital in commercial real estate financings in private investment grade mandates.

This is a financing and capital markets role rather than a traditional real estate acquisition or investment role. Deep knowledge of commercial real estate financing and lending markets is therefore critical.

**Responsibilities**

* Source, evaluate, structure and execute financing solutions across PIMCO's commercial real estate debt and equity portfolios and investment vehicles.
* Develop and maintain relationships with banks and other financing counterparties to identify appropriate sources of leverage including warehouse, loan on loan, and senior mezz.
* Lead the negotiation of warehouse facilities and other secured financing arrangements, including economic terms, collateral requirements, covenants and related legal documentation.
* Evaluate financing alternatives across individual investments, portfolios and fund or vehicle-level structures, balancing cost of capital, advance rates, structural protections, flexibility and liquidity.
* Partner closely with PIMCO's commercial real estate portfolio managers to understand investment pipelines, portfolio composition and expected financing requirements.
* Manage existing financing facilities, including collateral eligibility, borrowing capacity, covenants, margin requirements and other ongoing obligations.
* Assess financing implications associated with new CRE investments and portfolio construction and provide recommendations to portfolio managers and senior stakeholders.
* Monitor developments across CRE financing and capital markets and identify opportunities to improve or optimize financing structures.
* Prepare analysis and recommendations for senior investment professionals regarding leverage, financing capacity and financing strategy.
* Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations and other internal stakeholders in the execution and ongoing management of financing transactions.
* Over time, and depending on experience, support financing requirements across PIMCO's European commercial real estate debt activities.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in commercial real estate financing, capital markets, structured lending or a closely related area. Seniority can flex depending on the depth and relevance of the candidate's experience.
* Deep knowledge of commercial real estate debt financing is essential.
* Experience with CRE warehouse facilities or comparable portfolio financing structures.
* Strong understanding of secured lending structures, collateral analysis, advance rates, covenants and financing documentation.
* Demonstrated experience negotiating with banks, borrowers, asset managers, legal counsel and other transaction counterparties.

title: Reporter, Founder Brew
description:
At Morning Brew Inc., we mix what you need to know with our unique brand of wit to attract, and build real relationships with, the next generation of business leaders. We speak to them like people, ensuring they get the context and insight needed to make decisions every day. Loyalty and trust are our most valuable currencies.

Whether scrolling, reading, watching, or listening, our audience trusts us for credible, entertaining business content that makes an impact on their personal and professional lives.

The Morning Brew team is clever, creative, and growing fast. Want in? Read on.

OVERVIEW

Founder Brew, a publication dedicated to exploring the real lives, decisions, and psychology of people building companies — from startups to small businesses to creative ventures—is looking for a reporter to cover the operational truths of being a founder.

Founder Brew explores what it’s like building a business—across startups, small businesses, and “unsexy” real-world companies—and is a publication focused on how current and aspiring founders can be better equipped to handle what comes their way.

Reporting is pragmatically optimistic, and divided between two modes: as-told-to, and traditional reporting. We publish the messy middle, resist PR gloss, and verify the facts behind first-person stories.

We’re looking for a reporter to ideate, research, and create journalism to help take this vertical to new heights.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Pitch, report, and write 3-5 stories per week for Founder Brew.

* Generate ideas for and lead/co-lead creation of non-newsletter editorial initiatives, enterprise pieces, and evergreen content, as we build out a digital home.

* Conduct research to support creation of key stories and inform longer-term projects.

* Create multimedia components that bring our stories to life in video and audio formats

* When needed, represent Founder Brew at live events, with the possibility of on-stage participation.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* Interest and expertise in business writing and reporting

* At least 3 years of journalism experience

* Ability to write in the Morning Brew style (engaging, informative, clever)

* Ability to quickly source up

* Understanding of how to analyze and draw conclusions from structured and unstructured data

* Understanding of how to leverage multiple platforms (email, social media, etc.) to engage with the target audience

* Self-starter attitude with ability to operate in a collaborative, quickly-changing environment

* Combination of attention to detail and creative, strategic thinking

* Excellent communication skills with a mindset for collaboration

* Ability to operate in a high-pressure environment with tight deadlines

**COMPENSATION** $40-45/hr. This is a temp-to-perm position.

**BRIEF BREW HISTORY**

Morning Brew Inc. was founded in 2015 by two entrepreneurial college students who noticed their peers were not consuming legacy media resources about business and finance news, but had a high desire to learn about those topics. What started as a small on-campus email has since evolved into a multi-channel media company that operates 20+ unique content franchises. All while maintaining our witty, honest and engaging tone that millions of loyal MBI audience members rely upon daily to better navigate the world.

In 2020 a majority stake in MBI was acquired by Axel Springer SE and in February 2025 that position was increased to full ownership of the business. Axel Springer SE is a family-owned, transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York that is committed to the values of a free and informed society. To learn more about Axel Springer SE and what defines us, visit http://axelspringer.com/en/what-defines-us.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We're building the future of cloud financial management, and the hardest unsolved problem in it is AI cost. Customers are moving from experimenting with generative AI to running it in production at scale. Spend is driven by tokens, model choice, inference patterns, and increasingly by agents that make their own consumption decisions. The AWS Billing organization processes millions of events per second to deliver the cost, usage, and optimization insights that power financial decisions at the world's largest enterprises. We are now extending that foundation to give customers the ability to understand, allocate, control, and optimize AI spend with the same rigor they apply to compute and storage today.  
  
As Senior Product Manager, you will execute AWS's strategy for AI cost governance. This is the highest-ambiguity, highest-leverage product space in the organization: the mechanics of tokenomics, attribution, and control for generative AI workloads are still being defined across the industry, and the decisions made here set the direction that partner service teams, enterprise customers, and eventually all industry players respond to. You will own the product bets that define the category.  
  
In this role, you will define what it means to govern AI spend on AWS: how cost is attributed at the token, model, and agent level; how customers allocate that cost to teams, applications, and business units; and how they set and enforce controls before spend, rather than explaining it afterward. You will write the strategy documents and PR/FAQs for the most consequential launches, run the customer conversations, and make the hard trade-off calls on scope, sequencing, and where AWS should lead versus follow. You will pressure-test metering, API, and interface designs directly with engineering, and dig into consumption data and customer telemetry to understand where the real cost drivers and governance gaps are. You will own the measurement of whether these capabilities actually change customer behavior, including adoption, spend under active governance, and the degree to which cost visibility unblocks AI expansion, and build the review mechanisms that hold the organization accountable to it.  
  
You will make the calls on how AI cost governance extends to emerging surfaces, including foundation model inference, agentic workloads, and third-party and marketplace model consumption, and on when AWS should build new primitives versus extend existing cost management constructs. You will partner with engineering leaders, applied science leaders, and product leaders across Bedrock, AgentCore, and the broader AWS generative AI portfolio to ensure cost governance is designed in rather than retrofitted, and you will drive alignment on strategy and investment across multiple organizations without owning the teams that execute it. You will represent this product area to senior AWS leadership, enterprise CFOs and FinOps practitioners, and industry analysts, and you will shape how the market thinks about the economics of running AI in production.  
  
This role requires deep technical judgment, comfort operating with incomplete information on problems that have no precedent, and the influence to move organizations you do not control. If you are excited about defining a product category that does not yet exist — and about the fact that every enterprise scaling generative AI will eventually need what you build — this role offers the opportunity to set AWS's position on the economics of AI.

* Engage with customers through a variety of channels and serve as the voice of the customer internally.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, finance, or economics
* Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

SoulCycle is built on community, energy, and the feeling riders get when they walk out of a studio a little lighter than they walked in. As a Product Manager at SoulCycle, you will shape the products that carry that feeling beyond the bike: how riders discover, book, ride, and come back, and how our studio teams and instructors deliver an experience people love. You will drive the roadmap for our rider app, website, and studio technology, building lasting relationships with our riders and driving real business outcomes.

You will report to our VP, Product & Technology, and join our product team at a moment when the craft of product management is changing fast. We expect you to work the way modern product teams do: using AI every day to prototype, research, and analyze, so we can learn faster and ship things that matter. **Responsibilities**

As a Product Manager you will:

* Shape and drive the roadmap for the SoulCycle rider app, website, and studio technology. Develop a clear vision and strategy in partnership with the VP, Product & Technology, make sharp prioritization calls, and tie every bet to a rider or business outcome.
* Run continuous discovery. Talk to riders, studio staff, and instructors regularly, and use Claude to speed up synthesis of interviews, surveys, reviews, and support feedback so insights reach the team in days, not weeks.
* Prototype to learn. Turn ideas into working, clickable, or coded prototypes using AI-assisted design and development tools, and put them in front of users and stakeholders before we commit engineering time.
* Partner closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, and studio operations to deliver focused, iterative releases. Write clear, concise specs and use Claude to draft and pressure-test requirements, user stories, and edge cases.
* Own measurement. Define success metrics up front, instrument what you ship, and analyze feature and product performance yourself, using Looker, SQL, and AI-assisted analysis to understand adoption, retention, revenue, and rider behavior.
* Design and run experiments (A/B tests, pilots, phased rollouts), read the results with rigor, and make clear scale, iterate, or stop decisions.
* Identify opportunities to use AI in our products and operations, from personalization to smarter tools for studio teams, and evaluate them for value, quality, cost, and rider trust.
* Communicate with clarity. Share your thinking, trade-offs, and results with stakeholders from studio managers to executives, and keep the whole team focused on the outcomes that matter.
* Raise the bar on how we work. Proactively improve our product development process, tooling, and culture, and share what you learn about effective AI-enabled workflows with your peers.

  
**Qualifications**

A successful Product Manager will have:

* 3 or more years of hands-on product management experience, with a track record of shipping products that moved key metrics.
* Demonstrated fluency with AI tools in your daily work, such as large language models like Claude, AI prototyping and coding tools, and AI-assisted research and analysis, and good judgment about when to trust their output and when to verify it.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including comfort pulling and analyzing data yourself (SQL and a BI tool such as Looker), and a passion for data-driven decision-making.
* Experience with user research and discovery: running interviews, testing prototypes, and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into product decisions.
* Proven success partnering with a diverse range of stakeholders to create focus and deliver complex systems and products in an ever-evolving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to keep teams aligned on key outcomes.
* The ability to give and receive actionable, insightful feedback with fellow Product Managers to improve the SoulCycle experience as a whole.
* A personal passion for fitness and/or the SoulCycle brand.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with consumer mobile app, subscription, membership, or e-commerce products.
* Experience in fitness, wellness, hospitality, or other experience-driven businesses.
* Experience building or shipping AI-powered product features.

Pay Transparency: $125,000 - $140,000

 **Additional Information**

For additional Information visit our Career Site: https://www.soul-cycle.com/careers/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United States.

title: Director of Accounting
description:
Revivn is a profitable and rapidly growing company that helps enterprises manage their technology through our end of life software platform. We take electronic recycling one step further by repurposing hardware that still has remaining life and providing it to people who lack dedicated computer access and make it more affordable for people who may not be able to purchase new technology. Working with companies like Instacart, Adobe, Block, Etsy, Justworks, and Teach for America, we are changing the way companies view used technology with a new model that focuses on repurposing instead of recycling.

**Please note this role is based on-site at our Brooklyn Navy Yard office with Remote Wednesdays.**

**About the Role**
------------------

This is the top accounting seat at Revivn, and it is a build role, not a maintenance role. You will own the accounting function end to end — from the hands-on mechanics of AP, AR, month-end close, through to tax compliance, audit-readiness, and cash management strategy.

The role is deliberately broad. Today the accounting function closes the P&L on time and pays the bills; the opportunity is to expand it into a complete finance operation — full balance sheet reconciliations, a functioning receivables process, item-level reconciliation between our operational systems and QuickBooks, cash management, and insurance — and to build the team and tooling to support it. Longer term, that foundation gives Revivn a P&L per pickup and per client, and the audit-ready books we will need as we scale.

We are looking for someone who will not wait to be told what to work on. You will report to and partner closely with our VP of Finance, and you will have direct exposure to our co-CEOs. The expectation is that you bring your own point of view and push back when you think we have it wrong.

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Own the monthly close end to end, delivering a full P&L and complete balance sheet reconciliations.
* Run accounts payable as a responsive internal service partner to teams across the company, with obligations paid accurately and on time — and build a real accounts receivable process from the ground up, replacing what we have today with something current, disciplined, and fully operational
* Own sales and income tax compliance, managing our relationships with external providers
* Build a repeatable, item-level reconciliation between our operational system and QuickBooks so unit-level data ties cleanly to the financial statements
* Establish and run cash management strategy, including banking relationships and treasury
* Lead tax audits and tax credit projects.
* Manage and develop our junior accountant, and build out the team as scope grows — including eventual oversight of an international hire should we open a European facility
* Partner with FP&A, Engineering, and Operations to build P&L visibility at the pickup and client level

**We're looking for someone who has:**
--------------------------------------

* 6-8 years of progressive accounting experience.
* Fully owned an accounting function end to end at any size company.
* **Inventory accounting experience in a retail or manufacturing environment** (required)
* A technology-forward approach: fluent across multiple tools, uses data infrastructure and AI to improve process, and does not live exclusively in Excel
* Hands-on experience with QuickBooks or a comparable ERP, plus payroll processing
* Strong business acumen and the ability to explain complex financial topics simply to non-finance audiences
* Fluent, professional English

**Preferred:** CPA, CMA, or equivalent certification; experience leading an ERP implementation or upgrade.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Proactive and self-directed. You identify what needs to happen, validate your own assumptions, and move — rather than waiting for instructions.
* Not an order-taker. You bring independent ideas to the table and are willing to challenge your manager and leadership constructively when you see a better path.
* Comfortable with range. You will build the strategy and you will also close the books.
* A clear communicator who can make a complicated accounting topic land with someone who has never opened a general ledger.
* Ambitious about where this goes. This role has a path toward Controller.
**If this sounds like you, apply! If you don't meet all of the qualifications but think you could be a match, we'd still love the chance to review your application.**
 [...] **At Revivn, we prioritize transparency about our salary throughout the entire recruitment process. Be prepared to chat about compensation on your initial screen so that we can ensure alignment. If salary expectations and ranges are out of sync, we believe it is kind to respect everyone's time and may discontinue conversations.**
 [...] **For all job openings, we consider candidates with various backgrounds and levels of experience. When we give an offer it is based on individual skills and experience, as well as how that stacks up against other employees in the role. All of our ranges account for growth within the role, so in most cases, you should expect to join closer to the entry point of the band. You will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.**
The salary range for a Director of Accounting is expected to be between **$160,000-$180,000/year.** Your exact offer may vary based on these factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, and experience. The compensation package will also include comprehensive benefits such as medical, dental, and vision coverage, along with a 401(k) plan.

We're changing that.

Covera combines clinical expertise, advanced AI, and one of the industry's largest radiology quality datasets to help detect disease earlier, improve diagnostic accuracy, and give clinicians greater confidence in every decision they make. **Title:** Financial, Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Manager

**Reports to:** VP, Finance

**Location**: New York, NY – Onsite

**Industry:** Required experience in fashion, apparel, intimates, or beauty

**Employment:** Full-time, Exempt

**About the Role**

Gelmart Industries is seeking a hands-on FP&A professional who reports to the VP of Finance and helps leadership make informed decisions about what comes next. You will build forecasts, explain changes in expected performance, and turn financial and operating data into practical recommendations. This role requires an independent thinker who can connect the numbers to what is happening in the business, challenge assumptions, and recommend a course of action.

The expectation is no surprises. You will identify and communicate material risks, emerging variances, and changes in the outlook early enough for leadership to act. When an issue arises, you will assess its financial impact, update the forecast, and recommend a response rather than waiting for month-end reporting.

Gelmart’s intimate apparel wholesale business serves major national retailers. Your analysis will connect customer and program sales with inventory, sourcing costs, freight, duties, tariffs, and retailer deductions to show where revenue and margin are heading.

You will partner with the accounting team, who owns the monthly close and prepares closed-period financials. You will review and publish the monthly financial package for the VP of Finance, then use those actuals and current business information to guide forecasts and decisions.

Candidates **must have prior FP&A experience within the fashion, apparel, intimates, or beauty industries**, preferably in a wholesale business serving major national retailers. Direct industry experience is required for consideration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the annual budget and recurring forecasts for sales, margin, and expenses. Partner with business leaders to update assumptions as conditions change.
* Build and maintain financial models that connect sales volume, pricing, product mix, inventory, and landed costs to expected results. Document assumptions and use the models for scenario analysis.
* Monitor sales, margin, costs, and business activity by customer and program between reporting cycles. Flag material changes early, assess their financial impact, and recommend actions.
* Analyze pricing, customer and program profitability, cost changes, and proposed investments to support commercial and operating decisions.
* Review and publish the monthly financial package for the VP of Finance, including the financial statements, period review, and actual-to-budget comparison prepared by the Senior Accounting Manager. Resolve any questions before publication.
* Add a forward-looking assessment explaining what the results mean for the forecast, emerging risks and opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Own weekly EOS scorecard updates for assigned financial measures. Validate the data, compare results with agreed targets, and bring exceptions, emerging risks, and recommended actions to team meetings.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring data preparation and improve reporting, using AI where it supports analysis. Validate outputs, protect confidential information, and maintain financial controls.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of progressive finance experience, including budgeting, forecasting, or FP&A responsibility for a business unit.
* Experience in wholesale apparel or another business selling to major national retailers is required.
* Strong financial modeling skills, including the ability to define assumptions, test calculations, and maintain reliable models as business conditions change.
* Ability to interpret a P&L and balance sheet and connect operating activity to financial results. Experience with inventory, landed costs, duties, tariffs, retailer deductions, or factoring is a plus.
* Experience analyzing budget and forecast variances and communicating clear recommendations to business leaders. Multi-entity or multi-currency reporting is helpful.
* Sound commercial judgment and the confidence to challenge assumptions, work independently, and raise concerns early.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis skills, with an interest in improving manual processes and using reporting, automation, and AI tools effectively.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, NetSuite, or a similar system is preferred.

**About Rafar Group Companies**

Rafar Group Companies is the parent organization behind Gelmart Industries, Rafar Brands, Fullstride, and Rafar Manufacturing. Our businesses span intimate apparel wholesale, brands, and manufacturing. This role supports Gelmart's wholesale business within Rafar's broader finance organization.

Our core values are **Be Adaptable, Have High Standards, Play for Each Other, and Focus on the Outcome**. We use EOS, the Entrepreneurial Operating System, to set quarterly priorities, review performance, and resolve issues in regular team meetings. We look for people who take ownership, collaborate across teams, raise issues early, and follow through on commitments.

The Rafar Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Green Top Farms is a New York-based food service company specializing in farm-fresh meals for enterprise workplace dining and corporate catering. We partner with leading companies to deliver elevated daily dining and hospitality experiences, using seasonal ingredients and thoughtful operations to create consistent, high-quality service at scale.

We believe the results of strengthening that connection are better nutrition, tastier food, greater social justice, and reduced environmental impacts. Our menus reflect this attention to bringing nutritious, delicious food to those who need it most.

**Position Overview**

The Finance Manager owns the financial picture of our operation and makes it useful to the senior leaders who run the business. Reporting to the VP of Operations, this role turns raw numbers into insight: it builds and interprets reporting, surfaces the red flags that matter at the account level, and pushes financial accountability out to the sites so every account understands how it is performing.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role for a growth-stage company, with a near-term path to build the Finance team and a pathway to a Controller role. You will run the day-to-day financial operations, including client invoicing, vendor invoice management and project managing GTF’s outside bookkeeping teams, while partnering with Operations, Accounting, and the account teams. You will do the analysis and prepare and present monthly financial reviews, including directly to clients.

We are looking for a candidate who:

* Has been an onsite or unit controller, or an FP&A or finance manager, in multi-unit or large-account food service
* Reads a P&L and surfaces the key red flags that matter, not just the raw numbers

* Present financials to internal leadership and, when needed, directly to clients

Bill accurately and get paid on time.

* Support collections and consistent follow-up on open receivables

At Corebridge Financial, we believe action is everything. That’s why every day we partner with financial professionals and institutions to make it possible for more people to take action in their financial lives, for today and tomorrow.

**Who You’ll Work With**

New Markets is a new team within Corebridge’s Institutional Markets business. We find new commercial opportunities in international markets where Corebridge does not operate today. These opportunities may take the form of reinsurance, retail, or M&A, and we partner directly with the Corebridge teams that own each of those areas. For every opportunity, we work out what the business is worth and make sure Corebridge enters each market better informed than competitors.

  

When a transaction takes the form of assumed reinsurance, New Markets works hand in hand with the Assumed Reinsurance team, which owns origination, structuring, negotiation, and post-close management of the transaction, and with the Pricing team, which prices every deal and owns the pricing opinion. For opportunities that take other forms, we partner with Corebridge’s retail businesses and corporate development functions as appropriate.

  

The team is deliberately small and senior. We use AI tools, a panel of external partners (consulting actuaries, local counsel, auditors, and licensed local carriers), and expertise from across Corebridge to do work that would otherwise need a much larger organization.

At its core, this is discounted cash flow valuation of complex insurance liabilities: deeply understanding and driving any improvements needed in liability and asset cash flow projections, reflecting capital and collateral, and turning them into a clear, well-supported value. You will have the freedom to build the models and tools this work requires, drawing on best practices and partnering closely with Corporate Actuarial, Pricing, and other actuarial teams.

  

This role is for a hands-on technical leader: someone who does the core analysis personally, sets the standard for others, and uses AI tools to work faster and at greater scale. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

title: Senior Director, Precision Engagement
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

Precision Engagement is the team that owns how Pfizer decides where, how, and when to engage each healthcare professional, and the predictive signals those decisions rest on. It owns the agentic reasoning layer that takes brand strategy, patient and customer signals, and the scored impact of every way to engage, and compiles them into a prioritized, sequenced plan for each HCP that is executed through field and digital channels and learns from what happened. The team consists of four teams: Engagement Planning (the reasoning layer) and the three AI/ML predictive teams (Predictive HCP Engagement, Predictive Patient Solutions, and Predictive Media Engagement). The solutions run on a shared production runtime, data contracts, and MLOps and AgentOps infrastructure built with Applied Intelligence.

As Sr. Director, you are the senior technical authority for this stack and the leader accountable for its value. You lead a four-Director organization and own its results: the measurable impact of the components of Precision Engagement on US Commercial brand performance, their adoption by brand, field, and digital teams, and the prioritization of headcount, capacity, external partners, and investment across them. You own the vision, architecture, and roadmap for Precision Engagement; you run and evolve the production solutions through hands-on technical Directors; and you set and review the methodology for the advanced machine learning the team builds (counterfactual and uplift modeling, survival and event modeling, optimization under constraints) and the standards by which its agentic systems are built, evaluated, and audited. The design principle is yours to hold: what changes often (strategy, context, new signals) lives in reasoning, context, and skills under AgentOps with full traceability and explainability; machine learning is reserved for stable, well-defined problems such as counterfactual scoring and patient prediction; and experimentation is how the system learns, designed into it rather than run beside it. You are accountable for both layers working together and for the business acting on the result.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Engagement Planning —** Own the vision, architecture, and roadmap for the reasoning layer: how brand strategy and context enter it, how signals and scores are reasoned over, how decisions are compiled into a plan per HCP with priority, window, and fallback, and how the plan is executed and learned from. Hold the design principles: the unit of decision is the unit of execution; if a rule can do it, it is a rule; models for stable problems, reasoning for what changes.
* **Agentic systems & AgentOps —** Set and enforce the standards for how Engagement Planning is built and run as an agentic system: grounding in model outputs, evaluation against baselines and against the models it draws on, guardrails, cost, traceability and explainability, human oversight, and the auditability a regulated environment requires. Own the AgentOps practice: versioned prompts, context, and skills; evaluation sets; release and rollback.
* **Predictive HCP Engagement —** Own the HCP focused solutions (Dynamic Targeting and its successors): a stable, generalized counterfactual model of the incremental impact of each individually addressable way to engage an HCP (calls, emails, rep-triggered actions, and other channels executed per HCP), with MLOps that decides when it retrains rather than a fixed refresh calendar, and the refactor from monolithic pipelines to modular, automated ones.
* **Predictive Patient Solutions —** Own the patient-level prediction solutions: journey and event modeling, predictive and survival AI/ML models on longitudinal claims and EHR data, and the agentic pull-through that tells marketers and field teams which patient opportunities are emerging, where, and what is driving them.
* **Predictive Media Engagement—** Own the models for channels bought as lists or audiences: NPI-list media membership decisions, consumer audience and pathway models, and transparent, explainable allocation logic for digital and media channels, inside the budget envelopes brand strategy sets. Define the handshake with the teams that optimize within channels and with channel-level measurement of investment impact, and extend toward consumer engagement as that scope is approved.
* **Production platform & standards —** Own the production standards the solutions run to (data contracts from upstream platforms to the channels that act, decision records that make every automateddecision auditable, replay, release safety, MLOps and AgentOps) and the requirements for the shared runtime they consume. **ABOUT VFG ADVISORY**

VFG Advisory LLC has spent over 20 years as a trusted advisor to privately held businesses, high-net-worth individuals, and nonprofit organizations. We go beyond tax and audit: we’re strategic partners who help clients grow, protect, and transition their wealth and business interests.

Our mission: deliver accounting and advisory services with integrity, insight, and innovation, built on long-term relationships and tailored solutions. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where professionals grow their careers while making a real impact for clients and community.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Transaction Advisory Services is part of our M&A team, which serves clients on both sides of a deal and runs the firm’s own acquisitions. For clients, we provide sell-side exit readiness and buy-side financial due diligence on transactions typically between $2M and $100M+, for a wide variety of businesses, including manufacturing, distribution, professional services, technology, retail, construction, and more. For the firm, we run VFG’s own acquisitions of CPA firms, from first look through close and integration. The M&A team also takes on financial due diligence outside of M&A, such as forensic accounting, divorce cases, and sales tax audits, as well as Office of the CFO work such as securing financing, carve-outs, and customized KPIs. The team is small and growing, backed by a loyal client base and an active referral network. It works closely with firm leadership and includes colleagues with Big 4 and public accounting backgrounds.

Most transaction advisory roles put you on one side of one kind of deal. Here you will see how a deal looks from the seller’s side, the buyer’s side, and the principal’s chair.
